doc: Closed vocabulary of typed facts that generated actions may require or establish. Keyed by predicate name, unlike capability-guard-coverage.v1.json which is keyed by guard id and whose projection entries must resolve to a predicate declared here. Two orthogonal axes: resolution says how a fact is READ, settlement says who can MAKE IT TRUE. connected_to is the case that needs both: the browser can read it for free from an already-loaded connection list, but only the other person can ever make it true.

entity_types.person: A human identified by a spoken name and resolved to exactly one directory match.
entity_types.circle: A named location circle owned by or shared with the signed-in person.
entity_types.label: A user-chosen name for a saved place.

resolution.projection: Readable from redacted client state already on the wire: app runtime state or published voice surface metadata. Costs nothing and must never trigger I/O, because evaluateKaiActionAvailability is synchronous.
resolution.server_only: Requires a scoped backend call. Never resolved inside the synchronous availability path; a surface publishes it or a planner resolves it out of band.

settlement.agent: Some generated action establishes it. The planner may chain backward through it.
settlement.external: Only another person, another device, or an external system can make it true. The planner must defer and say so; it must never chain through it as though it could act.
settlement.ambient: Observed state that nothing in the app sets directly, such as an entitlement or the absence of another state. Never a planning target.

vault_unlocked.description: The vault is unlocked for this session.

vault_token.description: A vault owner token is present for this session.

analysis_active.description: An analysis run is currently in flight.

analysis_idle.description: No analysis run is in flight. The absence of analysis_active, not a thing any action sets.

gmail_connected.description: The Gmail connector holds a live authorization.

gmail_configured.description: Gmail connector configuration is complete enough to use.

consent_center_visible.description: The consent centre surface is available to this account.

ria_available.description: The RIA workspace is entitled for this account.

persona_investor.description: The investor persona is the active workspace.

persona_ria.description: The RIA persona is the active workspace.

location_permission_granted.description: The device has granted location permission. Only the operating system prompt can make this true, so the planner names it and stops rather than trying to satisfy it.

location_updates_paused.description: This device has stopped sending location updates.

sos_active.description: An emergency SOS incident is currently running.

share_recipient_selected.description: At least one recipient is selected in the share composer.

ask_recipient_selected.description: At least one person is selected in the location request composer.

check_in_recipient_selected.description: At least one recipient is selected for a check-in.

has_any_connection.description: The signed-in person has at least one accepted connection. Settlement is external because a request only becomes a connection when the other person accepts.

has_emergency_contact.description: At least one emergency contact is configured.

connected_to.description: The named person is an accepted connection. Read for free from the connection list the surface has already loaded; made true only when that person accepts. connect.send_request establishes connection_pending, never this.

connection_pending.description: A connection request to the named person has been sent and not yet answered.

share_active_with.description: A live location share to the named person exists right now.

request_pending_from.description: The named person has asked to see this person's location and is waiting on an answer. Only they can create it.

emergency_contact.description: The named person is on the emergency contact list.

location_setup_complete.description: The named person has finished their own Location setup. A fact about somebody else's account, so it is never resolved from this browser's state and only they can make it true.

circle_exists.description: A circle with the named name exists for this person.

circle_invite_pending.description: An unanswered invitation to the named circle is waiting. Someone else has to send it.

saved_location_exists.description: A saved place with the named label exists.
